message.content:
Here’s a quick “cheat‑sheet” you can use to find a 2‑hour‑or‑shorter movie that’s still within walking distance of Times Square (NYC).  
All the theaters listed below are literally a 5–10 minute walk from Times Square, so you’ll be able to hop out of the theater and back into the heart of Midtown in no time.

| Theater | Address | Typical Walking Time | How to Check Showtimes |
|---------|---------|----------------------|------------------------|
| **AMC Empire 25** | 234 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | AMC’s own site or the AMC app |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | Regal’s website or the Regal app |
| **AMC Times Square 8** | 226 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | AMC site/app |
| **AMC Times Square 12** | 226 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | AMC site/app |
| **Regal Cinemas 18** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | Regal site/app |
| **AMC Times Square 14** | 226 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min | AMC site/app |

---

### 1. Pick a Theater

Pick one of the theaters above. For example, let’s say you choose **AMC Empire 25**.

### 2. Find Current Movies

Open the theater’s website or app.  
For AMC: <https://www.amctheatres.com/movie-theaters/new-york-city/amc-empire-25>  
For Regal: <https://www.regmovies.com/theater/nyc-regal-cinemas-times-square>

Scroll to the “Now Showing” section. You’ll see a list of movies with their runtimes.

### 3. Filter by Runtime

Look for movies that list a runtime of **≤ 120 minutes**.  
If the runtime isn’t shown directly, you can usually click on the movie title to see details, or you can cross‑reference the title on a site like IMDb or TMDb.

### 4. Check Showtimes

Once you’ve identified a movie that fits the runtime requirement, click on the showtime grid to see all available times for the day.  
Make sure the showtime is convenient for you (e.g., you want to leave before 9 pm, or you’re looking for a matinee).

### 5. Book Your Ticket

Click “Buy Tickets” or “Reserve” to purchase online.  
You’ll receive a QR code or confirmation email that you can scan at the theater.

---

## Quick Example (Using AMC Empire 25)

| Movie Title | Runtime | Showtimes (Today) |
|-------------|---------|--------------------|
| **“The Last Voyage”** | 98 min | 12:30 pm, 3:00 pm, 6:00 pm, 9:00 pm |
| **“Echoes of Tomorrow”** | 115 min | 1:15 pm, 4:45 pm, 8:15 pm |
| **“Hidden Horizons”** | 122 min | *Not eligible – exceeds 2 hrs* |

*(Note: These titles and times are illustrative; check the actual AMC site for up‑to‑date info.)*

---

## Handy Tips

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| **Use Google “Movie Times Near Times Square”** | Google often pulls showtimes from multiple theaters and shows them in a convenient list. |
| **Set a Reminder** | Some theaters allow you to set a reminder for a specific showtime. |
| **Check for Matinees** | Many theaters offer discounted tickets for matinee showings (usually before 4 pm). |
| **Look for “Short Films” or “Indie”** | These are more likely to be under 2 hours. |
| **Ask the Theater Staff** | If you’re already there, the staff can quickly tell you which movies are under 2 hours. |

---

### Final Checklist

1. **Choose a theater** (AMC Empire 25, Regal Times Square, etc.).  
2. **Open the theater’s website or app**.  
3. **Find the “Now Showing” list**.  
4. **Filter for movies ≤ 120 min**.  
5. **Select a convenient showtime**.  
6. **Book online** (or buy a ticket at the box office).  

Enjoy your movie! 🎬
